messages:
Jules: dropping a new concept for preview UX: a 'Preview sandbox' that defaults to simulated sends but lets you route to a staging channel (send-to-stage) for end-to-end checks. figma: https://figma.redwood/preview-sandbox-v1
Marta: good idea. couple things: how do we indicate that staging is live? don't want ppl to think it's production. propose a tag: 'Staging channel (test only)' and a red outline on the preview card when routed live.
Eli: backend note: add `preview_mode: simulated|stage|live` and `stage_channel_id`. we should gate stage sends by role (only Workspace Admins or with `preview.send:stage`).
Jules: yes, permission gating is important. default users see Simulated; 'Send to stage' requires a confirm modal and checks permissions.
Sara: copy tweaks: change 'Send to stage' -> 'Route to staging channel' (clearer). banner text: "Preview sandbox — simulated by default. Staging sends are test-only and won't go to customers."
Marta: a11y nits: banner must be role=status and keyboard-focusable when first opening preview. confirmation modal needs focus trap and aria-modal=true. if Send-to-stage is denied, show an inline explanation with a link to request access.
Eli: telemetry plan: emit `preview.send.attempt` with {mode, user_id, allowed:true|false, channel_id}. server should still log attempted deliveries even when simulated/blocked.
Jules: UX interaction: small dropdown on the preview header with options: Simulated, Route to staging, Send live (disabled behind a flag). each option should have short helper text when hovered.
Sara: keyboard shortcuts: press "P" to toggle preview mode, Shift+P to open the mode menu. announce mode changes via live region: "Preview mode changed to Route to staging".
Marta: contrast: the 'staging' pill color must meet AA on both light/dark. also add visible focus ring >3px for the mode menu.
Eli: API example for stage send: POST /v1/alerts/:id/preview { "mode":"stage", "stage_channel_id":"slack:999" } -> returns { "preview_id":"pv_1", "status":"queued" }
Jules: acceptance criteria to add to ticket ALERT-7210: 1) simulated previews never deliver, but are audited; 2) stage sends require permission and confirm modal; 3) UI exposes clear visual affordance that staging != production; 4) keyboard & screen-reader flows pass a11y checklist.
notify-bot: created ticket ALERT-7210 and linked design doc: https://redwood.workspaces/docs/preview-sandbox
Jules: I'll update Figma with the mode dropdown, confirm modal copy, and the staging pill variants. will post revised frames here. tagging @Eli for API contract and @Marta for accessibility signoff :thumbsup:
Eli: will draft server flag `preview_sandbox.v1` and add tests for audit emission and permission checks.
Sara: adding microcopy variants to the doc: option A uses 'Route to staging channel', option B 'Send test to staging'. leaning toward A. will post both in the doc for quick review.
Marta: i'll run quick a11y pass once the frames are up. thanks all!
